evals.name: onboard-new-repo
evals.prompt: 我在 /home/god/.cache/cgs-eval/alpha 这个仓库里干活。把它接入周报系统并立即收集一下——只采集我的提交（我的邮箱是 dev@example.com），项目范围 personal。
evals.expected_output: Looks up the repo, finds no source, runs the onboarding flow: creates exactly one git-local source (owner = repo path, authorEmails = [dev@example.com], projectScope personal, name alpha, all-branches mode), triggers the first sync, and reports the sync summary (commits scanned, new events).
assertions: source owner is the alpha repo path
4 events collected (email filter held; would be 6 if unfiltered)
final report contains a sync summary with commit/event counts

evals.name: trigger-existing-source
evals.prompt: cd 到 /home/god/.cache/cgs-eval/beta 这个仓库，触发一下采集，我想把最新提交收进来。
evals.expected_output: Looks up the repo, finds the existing enabled source, syncs it by id, reports the summary. No source is created or modified.
assertions: no new source created (the two seeded sources remain)
2 events collected for the beta source

evals.name: enable-disabled-source
evals.prompt: cd 到 /home/god/.cache/cgs-eval/gamma 这个仓库同步一下。这个源之前被我禁用了，直接启用并同步就行。
evals.expected_output: Lookup finds a disabled source; enables it (PATCH enabled=true) then syncs, reporting the summary. No new source created; emails unchanged.
assertions: no new source created (the two seeded sources remain)
1 event collected for the gamma source

evals.name: not-a-git-repo
evals.prompt: cd 到 /tmp/cgs-eval-plain 这个目录，收集一下当前仓库。
evals.expected_output: Detects the directory is not a git repository and stops with a clear error. Nothing is created or modified on the server.
assertions: no collect source exists after the run
report states the directory is not a git repository
